label: dune build
command: (cd <bench-workdir>/work/build/warblre-pinned && OPAMROOT=<bench-workdir>/work/opam OPAMCOLOR=never OPAMNODEPEXTS=1 DUNE_CACHE=disabled timeout --kill-after=60 4200 taskset --cpu-list 24-27 nice -n 10 opam exec --switch <bench-workdir>/work/switches/rocq-9.2.0 -- dune build -j 4 @mechanization/all @engines/all)
